theWidgetsGeneralOfflineNotice: The widget's general offline notice shown when no operators are online. Different from the live-chat “No-operators handoff message” (under Live chat & leads). Keep it warm and action-oriented.
liveChatCopyIsAvailable: Live-chat copy is available on Starter and up.
theBotLinksAKeyword: The bot links a keyword only where it fits the sentence, at most once per reply. Every row needs a keyword and an http(s) link; blank or invalid rows are dropped when you save.
enterAFullLinkStarting: Enter a full link starting with http:// or https:// - other rows are saved but this one is skipped until it is valid.
noSmartLinksYetAdd: No smart links yet. Add one - for example, keyword “pricing” linking to your pricing page - and the bot will hyperlink it whenever it naturally comes up in an answer.
onceYouSaveAtLeast: Once you save at least one service, the bot refuses questions outside this list. Links are optional.
noServicesListedTheBot: No services listed - the bot answers about anything in your knowledge base. Add one or more to scope its answers.
chooseWhichFieldsToCollect: Choose which fields to collect and whether each one is required.
mostVisitorsAllowedToWait: Most visitors allowed to wait in the queue at once (
howLongAVisitorWaits: How long a visitor waits before timing out (
timeBeforeTheHandoffForm: Time before the handoff form appears after the AI Chatbot suggests live chat.
thisChatbotDoesntExistOr: This chatbot doesn’t exist or you don’t have access to it.
weHitAProblemLoading: We hit a problem loading your chatbots. Refresh to try again.
couldNotSavePleaseTry: Could not save. Please try again.
couldNotLoadThisChatbots: Could not load this chatbot’s settings.
removeOyechatsBrandingFromThe: Remove OyeChats branding from the widget
upgradeYourPlanToHide: Upgrade your plan to hide the “Powered by OyeChats” footer.
hideThePoweredByOyechats: Hide the “Powered by OyeChats” footer from the widget.
anythingYouWriteHereReplaces: Anything you write here replaces the built-in wording, which your chatbot would otherwise translate for each visitor. Leave a field empty to keep the translated default.
customTextIsShownUnchanged: Custom text is shown unchanged in all languages.
livePreviewTestYourBot: Live preview - test your bot & watch edits update in real time
sorryICouldntAnswerThat: Sorry, I couldn’t answer that just now.
pastConversationsKeepTheLanguage: Past conversations keep the language they were held in, so turning this back on restores them.
theWidgetsLanguageSelectorDisappears: The widget’s language selector disappears, your chatbot answers everyone in its default language, and live chat is no longer translated for your team.
addASecondLanguageTo: Add a second language to give visitors something to switch to.
letVisitorsSwitchLanguageIn: Let visitors switch language in the widget
usedWhenAVisitorsLanguage: Used when a visitor’s language can’t be determined. Only supported languages can be the default.
theWidgetIsNotTranslated: The widget is not translated into some of these languages.
onlyLanguagesTheChatWidget: Only languages the chat widget itself is translated into can be added, so visitors never meet an English interface around a translated conversation.
aChatbotNeedsAtLeast: A chatbot needs at least one language.
noQuickActionsYetAdd: No quick actions yet. Add a few common questions to guide visitors.
askMeAnythingIAnswer: Ask me anything - I answer from your knowledge base.
subtitle: Subtitle
hiThereHowCanI: Hi there, how can I help you today?
eGAcmeIncBuilds: e.g. Acme Inc. builds project-management software for remote teams.
theNameOfYourBusiness: The name of your business or brand.
streamsARealAnswerUsing: Streams a real answer using your chatbot's saved settings - save your voice changes first to hear them here.
warmAndApproachableWithA: Warm and approachable, with a touch of humour. Avoid jargon.
trainOnYourWebsiteFirst: Train on your website first to detect a tone
inferABrandToneFrom: Infer a brand tone from your trained website
eGYouAreA: e.g. You are a friendly support assistant for Acme Inc. Be concise and offer to connect visitors to a human when unsure.
couldNotGenerateASample: Could not generate a sample reply.
couldNotDetectATone: Could not detect a tone. Please try again.
toneDetectedFromYourWebsite: Tone detected from your website and saved.
openPreviewInANew: Open preview in a new tab
yourSiteMayBlockBeing: Your site may block being embedded. The widget still works on the live site once installed.
websitePreviewWithTheChat: Website preview with the chat widget
